prompt:
Research the official free-tier limits of the GitHub Actions service for public and private repositories (minutes, storage, concurrency). Cite the GitHub documentation page you used.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Based on the GitHub documentation provided, here are the official free-tier limits for GitHub Actions, organized by category:

**Quick Summary:**
- **Public repositories:** Unlimited minutes on standard GitHub-hosted runners; free.
- **Private repositories:** Monthly minute quotas vary by plan (2,000–50,000 minutes); storage allowances vary from 500 MB to 50 GB for artifacts and 10 GB for cache.
- **Concurrency:** Ranges from 20 concurrent jobs (Free plan) to 1,000 (Larger runners); macOS concurrency is capped separately.
- **Job execution:** 6 hours for GitHub-hosted runners; 5 days for self-hosted.

---

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "GitHub Actions usage is **free** for **self-hosted runners** and for **public repositories** that use standard GitHub-hosted runners." | CLAIM: Public repositories using standard GitHub-hosted runners have free usage (implying unlimited minutes) and self-hosted runners are also free.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-github-actions/about-billing-for-github-actions | QUOTE: "The use of standard GitHub-hosted runners is free: In public repositories" | CLAIM: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners | QUOTE: "Use of the standard GitHub-hosted runners is free and unlimited on public repositories." | CLAIM: Public repositories receive unlimited free minutes on standard GitHub-hosted runners.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "For **private repositories**, each GitHub account receives a quota of free minutes, artifact storage, and cache storage for use with GitHub-hosted runners, depending on the account's plan. Any usage beyond the included amounts is billed to your account." | CLAIM: Private repositories have monthly quotas for minutes, artifact storage, and cache storage, with overages billed.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Free | 500 MB | 2,000 | 10 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Free plan includes 2,000 minutes per month, 500 MB artifact storage, and 10 GB cache storage for private repositories.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Pro | 1 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Pro plan includes 3,000 minutes per month, 1 GB artifact storage, and 10 GB cache storage.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Free for organizations | 500 MB | 2,000 | 10 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Free for organizations includes 2,000 minutes per month, 500 MB artifact storage, and 10 GB cache storage.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Team | 2 GB | 3,000 | 10 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Team plan includes 3,000 minutes per month, 2 GB artifact storage, and 10 GB cache storage.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "| GitHub Enterprise Cloud | 50 GB | 50,000 | 10 GB |" | CLAIM: GitHub Enterprise Cloud includes 50,000 minutes per month, 50 GB artifact storage, and 10 GB cache storage.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Free | 20 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: Free plan allows 20 total concurrent jobs with a maximum of 5 concurrent macOS jobs on standard GitHub-hosted runners.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Pro | 40 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: Pro plan allows 40 total concurrent jobs with a maximum of 5 concurrent macOS jobs.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Team | 60 | 5 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: Team plan allows 60 total concurrent jobs with a maximum of 5 concurrent macOS jobs.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Standard GitHub-hosted runner | Enterprise | 500 | 50 | Not applicable |" | CLAIM: Enterprise plan allows 500 total concurrent jobs with a maximum of 50 concurrent macOS jobs.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Larger runner | Team | 1000 | 5 | 100 |" | CLAIM: Team plan with larger runners allows 1,000 total concurrent jobs, 5 concurrent macOS jobs, and 100 concurrent GPU jobs.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Larger runner | Enterprise | 1000 | 50 | 100 |" | CLAIM: Enterprise plan with larger runners allows 1,000 total concurrent jobs, 50 concurrent macOS jobs, and 100 concurrent GPU jobs.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| All GitHub-hosted runners | Job execution time | 6 hours | Each job in a workflow can run for up to 6 hours of execution time. If a job reaches this limit, the job is terminated and fails. |" | CLAIM: GitHub-hosted runners have a maximum job execution time of 6 hours.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Self-hosted | Job execution time | 5 days | Each job in a workflow can run for up to 5 days of execution time. If a job reaches this limit, the job is terminated and fails. |" | CLAIM: Self-hosted runners have a maximum job execution time of 5 days.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/limits | QUOTE: "| Self-hosted | Job queue time | 24 hours | A job can be in the queue for 24 hours before it is automatically cancelled. |" | CLAIM: Jobs on self-hosted runners can wait in the queue for up to 24 hours before automatic cancellation.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "The storage amounts shown are **shared** with GitHub Packages. This means your total storage across Actions artifacts, Actions caches, and Packages cannot exceed the included amount for your plan." | CLAIM: Artifact storage limits are shared with GitHub Packages (though the provided text has ambiguity about whether cache is included; the billing page states "Cache storage and custom image storage are separate allowances").

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions | QUOTE: "Larger runners are always charged for, even when used by public repositories or when you have quota available from your plan." | CLAIM: Larger runners incur charges even for public repositories or when free quota remains.

**SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners | QUOTE: "Single-CPU runners are hosted in a container on a shared VM" | CLAIM: Single-CPU runners (ubuntu-slim) use containers on shared VMs rather than dedicated VMs.
